title: The Brown-hypotheses bundle for a condensed coefficient
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a commutative condensed ring. Put $S=\mathrm D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ and $L=\operatorname{Loc}(S)$ as in [sk-def-localizing-closure]. The proposition $\mathrm{BrownHypothesesFor}(\Lambda,X)$ bundles: $L$ is locally small and triangulated with the canonical inherited shift, replete, and idempotent complete; $S$ is thick [pur9-def-thick] and essentially small; and there is a coproduct structure in the fixed Hom universe on $L$ such that, for every small category equivalent to $S$ and every lift of its objects to $L$, those representatives are compact [def-pc-compact-object] and form a triangulated generating family [def-pc-generators]. This is only a definition, with no assertion that it holds for any $X$ or $\Lambda$.
